apppress/activity-log.name: AppPress Activity Log
apppress/activity-log.description: Immutable audit trail for every action across your AppPress platform — tracks who did what, when, across all core and plugin events. Provides a filterable, exportable admin log, channel-specific workflow triggers, REST ingestion for external systems, and a before_record filter for FERPA/privacy suppression. Implements StandardContracts::AUDIT_LOG so any plugin or App Pack can write to the log without a direct dependency.
apppress/activity-log.author: AppPress

apppress/airtable-connector.name: Airtable Connector
apppress/airtable-connector.description: Connect Airtable bases for schema-flexible record read/search/create/update and workflow automation on record changes.
apppress/airtable-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/analytics.name: AppPress Analytics
apppress/analytics.description: Privacy-friendly, FERPA-aware analytics that tracks page views, visitor sessions, UTM campaigns, and custom events — with a built-in admin dashboard and configurable data retention. Works out of the box for public pages; requires FERPA review before enabling authenticated-user tracking in campus apps.
apppress/analytics.author: AppPress

apppress/anti-spam.name: AppPress Anti-Spam
apppress/anti-spam.description: Multi-layer spam and abuse protection for public-facing forms, registration flows, and community content. Combines honeypot fields, content pattern analysis, CAPTCHA (reCAPTCHA v3 / hCaptcha), IP reputation scoring, automatic IP blocking, and a moderation quarantine queue — all configurable without code. Fires workflow triggers on every spam event and exposes workflow actions to block IPs, approve/reject quarantine items, and scan arbitrary content on demand.
apppress/anti-spam.author: AppPress

apppress/api-keys.name: AppPress API Keys
apppress/api-keys.description: Named API keys with scoped permissions, per-key rate limiting, usage analytics, zero-downtime key rotation, and full connector/workflow integration. Implements StandardContracts::API_KEYS.
apppress/api-keys.author: AppPress

apppress/appointments.name: AppPress Appointments
apppress/appointments.description: Let members, clients, or students book time slots with staff or service providers. Manages bookable services, weekly availability windows, automatic slot generation, conflict detection, capacity limits, cancellation policies, and pre-appointment reminders. Supports optional external scheduler ingress (Calendly, etc.) and calendar sync. Implements StandardContracts::APPOINTMENTS so App Packs and other plugins can book and query appointments without direct coupling.
apppress/appointments.author: AppPress

apppress/approvals.name: AppPress Approvals
apppress/approvals.description: Approval workflow plugin that assigns sign-off requests to any record (quote, form, document, or custom entity), captures approve/reject decisions with a full audit trail, fires 8 workflow triggers for automation, and bridges to DocuSign for e-signatures. Use this plugin whenever an app needs a human to review and sign off on something before a process can continue.
apppress/approvals.author: AppPress

apppress/asana-connector.name: Asana Connector
apppress/asana-connector.description: Production Asana connector for CampusLaunch — find/create/update tasks, read projects and sections, and inbound workflow triggers for task-created and task-completed events via Asana's signed webhook handshake.
apppress/asana-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/assignments.name: AppPress Assignments
apppress/assignments.description: Assignment submission, rubric grading, and grade management for LMS and campus apps. Supports due dates, late penalties, pass/fail thresholds, file uploads, SIS/LMS grade import via signed webhook, and workflow automation covering the full submission lifecycle: created → published → submitted → graded → passed/failed → returned.
apppress/assignments.author: AppPress

apppress/backup.name: AppPress Backup & Restore
apppress/backup.description: Protect your AppPress site with automated database and file backups — scheduled or on-demand, stored locally or on S3-compatible storage, optionally AES-256 encrypted, with retention policies, integrity verification, and one-click restore. Implements StandardContracts::BACKUP so App Packs and workflows can trigger backups without direct coupling. Not a content JSON export — use core export for site migration; use this plugin for disaster recovery.
apppress/backup.author: AppPress

apppress/billing.name: AppPress Billing
apppress/billing.description: Stripe-powered subscription billing with plans, feature quotas, usage tracking, customer portal, and webhook sync. Implements StandardContracts::BILLING and emits eight outbound workflow triggers (subscription_created, subscription_cancelled, subscription_renewed, payment_failed, payment_succeeded, plan_changed, trial_started, trial_ended). Provides workflow actions for sending payment links, cancelling subscriptions, checking subscription status, assigning plans, and recording usage. Exposes connector query surfaces for subscriptions, invoices, and feature usage.
apppress/billing.author: AppPress

apppress/blog.name: AppPress Blog
apppress/blog.description: Full blog and content publishing engine with post scheduling, revision history with restore, RSS feed, category management, reading time, and cross-plugin integrations for tags, activity logging, analytics, and workflows.
apppress/blog.author: AppPress

apppress/booking-appointments.name: Booking & Appointments
apppress/booking-appointments.description: Client booking pages, booking records pipeline, calendars, and notification workflows.
apppress/booking-appointments.author: AppPress

apppress/booking-portal.name: Booking & Appointments Portal
apppress/booking-portal.description: Publish services, accept bookings, sync schedules, collect deposits, and manage appointments.
apppress/booking-portal.author: AppPress

apppress/brightspace-d2l-connector.name: Brightspace D2L LMS Connector
apppress/brightspace-d2l-connector.description: D2L Brightspace LMS connector for CampusLaunch — course listing, section lookup, enrollment read (FERPA-gated), announcement creation, assignment due-date triggers, grade summary (permission-gated), and deep links back to Brightspace. Banner/SIS writeback is excluded by design.
apppress/brightspace-d2l-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/calendar.name: AppPress Calendar
apppress/calendar.description: Shared calendar and scheduling primitive — events with RRULE recurrence, availability windows, iCal import/export, and certified connector sync with Google Calendar and Outlook. Powers apppack-booking, apppack-project-management, apppack-lms, and CRM.
apppress/calendar.author: AppPress

apppress/campus-event-ops.name: Campus Event Ops
apppress/campus-event-ops.description: Time-bound campus micro-apps: orientation, move-in, career fair, and event registration with QR check-in, maps, surveys, and staff dashboards.
apppress/campus-event-ops.author: AppPress

apppress/cas-sso-connector.name: CAS SSO Connector
apppress/cas-sso-connector.description: Central Authentication Service (CAS) SSO connector for CampusLaunch — CAS 2.0/3.0 ticket validation, login URL generation, attribute extraction, role mapping, JIT user provisioning, multi-tenant campus isolation, and logout support.
apppress/cas-sso-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/certificates.name: AppPress Certificates
apppress/certificates.description: Issue and verify PDF certificates for course completions, quiz passes, and custom achievements. Supports customizable HTML/CSS templates with dynamic variable substitution.
apppress/certificates.author: AppPress

apppress/changelog.name: AppPress Changelog
apppress/changelog.description: Product changelog and release notes system for campus apps and SaaS products. Teams publish versioned entries (new, improvement, fix, security, deprecation) with rich content, schedule releases, track reads and reactions, and email digest notifications to subscribers. Exposes mobile What's New surfaces, admin dashboard blocks, workflow triggers, and the StandardContracts::CHANGELOG service for App Packs.
apppress/changelog.author: AppPress

apppress/chat.name: AppPress Chat
apppress/chat.description: Real-time messaging with channels, DMs, threading, reactions, presence, and file attachments. Implements StandardContracts::CHAT.
apppress/chat.author: AppPress

apppress/client-desk.name: Client Desk
apppress/client-desk.description: A premium, understated theme for agencies and professional-services firms running client portals. Deep slate + muted gold palette, refined Space Grotesk headings, generous whitespace, and calm, professional client-desk styling layered over the Default theme.
apppress/client-desk.author: AppPress

apppress/client-portal.name: Client Portal
apppress/client-portal.description: One private place for clients to access files, invoices, messages, and approvals.
apppress/client-portal.author: AppPress

apppress/clinic-pro.name: Clinic Pro
apppress/clinic-pro.description: A calm, reassuring theme for health clinics and wellness practices — online booking, patient portals, and appointment reminders. Teal-and-sky palette, Mulish display type, gentle gradient hero, and trust-focused styling layered over the Default theme.
apppress/clinic-pro.author: AppPress

apppress/cloud-vps.name: AppPress Cloud VPS Provider
apppress/cloud-vps.description: Platform-level cloud infrastructure provider for AppPress Cloud. Provisions DigitalOcean VPS instances, manages DNS records, bootstraps AppPress via cloud-init with Let's Encrypt SSL, and remotely installs App Packs/plugins via machine-token API. Listens to marketplace InstanceProvisioned/Terminated/Suspended/Resumed events. Not for campus or tenant-site blueprints — operator infrastructure only.
apppress/cloud-vps.author: AppPress

apppress/commerce-pro.name: Commerce Pro
apppress/commerce-pro.description: A confident, product-forward theme for online stores. Rose-and-amber palette, Poppins display type, a bold gradient hero, and Sale/New badge styling layered over the Default theme.
apppress/commerce-pro.author: AppPress

apppress/community-pro.name: Community Pro
apppress/community-pro.description: A warm, welcoming theme for membership communities, forums, and social spaces. Burnt-orange-and-teal palette, friendly Nunito type, rounded avatar-driven layouts, and member-first styling layered over the Default theme.
apppress/community-pro.author: AppPress

apppress/composed-app.name: Composed App
apppress/composed-app.description: Shell App Pack for AI-authored assemblies. Objects, forms, workflows, and dashboards are provisioned from validated blueprints.
apppress/composed-app.author: AppPress

apppress/contacts.name: AppPress Contacts
apppress/contacts.description: CRM-style contact and company management with lifecycle stages, notes, tasks, and activity tracking.
apppress/contacts.author: AppPress

apppress/content-drip.name: AppPress Content Drip
apppress/content-drip.description: Scheduled, prerequisite-based, and time-gated content release for AppPress. Supports course dripping, onboarding sequences, and membership content.
apppress/content-drip.author: AppPress

apppress/contractor-connector-pack.name: Contractor Connector Pack
apppress/contractor-connector-pack.description: Quote request portal with certified QuickBooks, HubSpot, and Google Sheets connector workflows for contractors.
apppress/contractor-connector-pack.author: AppPress

apppress/coupons.name: AppPress Coupons
apppress/coupons.description: Discount codes and coupons with percentage and fixed-amount discounts, usage limits, expiration dates, plan restrictions, and redemption tracking.
apppress/coupons.author: AppPress

apppress/custom-fields.name: AppPress Custom Fields
apppress/custom-fields.description: Dynamic custom field groups and fields attachable to any model, with type validation, field groups, and a clean API for reading and writing values.
apppress/custom-fields.author: AppPress

apppress/discussions.name: AppPress Discussions
apppress/discussions.description: Threaded discussion system: polymorphic threads, nested replies, emoji reactions, upvotes, @mentions, pin/lock/close, moderation queue, spam integration.
apppress/discussions.author: AppPress

apppress/documents.name: AppPress Documents
apppress/documents.description: HTML templating and PDF generation for workflows and business records: admin/app document library with templates, member documents panel/page, expiring share links, PDF uploads, generated-document retention, and workflow triggers/actions (core.generate_pdf, documents.pdf_generated, send_document). Implements StandardContracts::DOCUMENTS.
apppress/documents.author: AppPress

apppress/docusign-connector.name: DocuSign Connector
apppress/docusign-connector.description: Production DocuSign eSignature connector for CampusLaunch — send envelopes for signature from templates, track envelope and recipient status, list/search envelopes, void envelopes, and inbound Connect webhook triggers for envelope-completed and recipient-completed events.
apppress/docusign-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/dropbox-connector.name: Dropbox Connector
apppress/dropbox-connector.description: Production Dropbox connector for AppPress — find/upload/move files and folders, short-lived download links instead of embedded file bytes, and an inbound workflow trigger for file changes driven by Dropbox's real notification-only webhook (list_folder/continue delta discovery), with the GET challenge-echo handshake required for subscription registration.
apppress/dropbox-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/email-campaigns.name: AppPress Email Campaigns
apppress/email-campaigns.description: Operator-managed email marketing: mailing lists with double opt-in, HTML campaigns, scheduled queue-based sends, open/click tracking, bounce webhooks, RFC 8058 unsubscribe, and site-scoped analytics. Implements StandardContracts::EMAIL_CAMPAIGNS.
apppress/email-campaigns.author: AppPress

apppress/events.name: AppPress Events
apppress/events.description: Campus event management with ticket types, capacity control, waitlist promotion, QR-based check-in, and guest or authenticated registration. Implements StandardContracts::EVENTS for cross-plugin registration flows.
apppress/events.author: AppPress

apppress/excel-connector.name: Microsoft Excel Connector
apppress/excel-connector.description: Microsoft Excel connector via Graph API — read/write workbook tables, append rows, export records to Excel, import rosters and course data, and map CampusLaunch form fields to Excel columns. ETag concurrency protection prevents data loss.
apppress/excel-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/feature-flags.name: AppPress Feature Flags
apppress/feature-flags.description: Site-scoped boolean, percentage, segment, and plan-based feature flags with per-user and global overrides, expiring overrides, and evaluation caching. Implements StandardContracts::FEATURE_FLAGS so host plugins gate features without hard dependencies. Operator-only — flags are resolved server-side via contract or service injection, not member UI.
apppress/feature-flags.author: AppPress

apppress/file-vault.name: AppPress File Vault
apppress/file-vault.description: User-scoped file storage with per-user quotas, disk-backed uploads, signed download URLs, folder organization, and usage tracking. Implements StandardContracts::FILE_VAULT so App Packs, forms, and workflows can store private documents without coupling to this plugin. Ships a dual-mounted (Studio + App) admin dashboard with upload, search/filter (including folder), bulk delete, and a quota bar; a member-facing My Files page for self-service upload/download/delete/share; an embeddable member block; inline image/PDF previews on both surfaces; a member dashboard panel; mobile ListScreen and interactive DetailScreen; workflow triggers/actions; and outbound webhooks.
apppress/file-vault.author: AppPress

apppress/forms.name: AppPress Forms
apppress/forms.description: Drag-and-drop form builder for public intake and operator-managed capture — submissions, email notifications, honeypot and rate-limit spam protection, optional anti-spam middleware, CSV export, workflow triggers, and mobile FormScreen embeds. Implements StandardContracts::FORMS.
apppress/forms.author: AppPress

apppress/freshdesk-connector.name: Freshdesk Connector
apppress/freshdesk-connector.description: Production Freshdesk support-desk connector for AppPress — create, update, and annotate tickets, list/search tickets, look up contacts and companies, and inbound webhook triggers for ticket-created and ticket-updated events.
apppress/freshdesk-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/gamification.name: AppPress Gamification
apppress/gamification.description: Gamification product: points/XP, badges, achievements, leaderboards, streaks, and named user levels with per-tier rewards. Dual-mounted (Studio + app) admin builders for badges/achievements/leaderboard/settings; a themed member profile panel (level ring, streak, rank, badges, achievements, earn/level-up celebration); a public/member themed leaderboard page; placeable points/badge/leaderboard blocks and shortcodes; and workflow actions so any plugin can award points or badges without coupling.
apppress/gamification.author: AppPress

apppress/geo.name: AppPress Geo & Location
apppress/geo.description: Shared geolocation primitive for AppPress — structured addresses, Nominatim geocoding, Haversine proximity search, public address autocomplete, and mobile MapScreen points. Consumed by contacts, events, appointments, and campus map app packs via StandardContracts::GEO.
apppress/geo.author: AppPress

apppress/github-connector.name: GitHub Connector
apppress/github-connector.description: Production GitHub connector for AppPress — find/create issues, comment on issues, and read repositories via workflow automation, with real issue/comment webhooks.
apppress/github-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/google-calendar-connector.name: Google Calendar Connector
apppress/google-calendar-connector.description: Production Google Calendar connector for CampusLaunch — event create/update/delete/get, calendar listing, free/busy availability lookups, search, and webhook triggers for event created/updated via Google's Calendar Watch push notifications.
apppress/google-calendar-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/gusto-connector.name: Gusto Connector
apppress/gusto-connector.description: Production Gusto connector for CampusLaunch — read/search employees, read compensation rates, and read payroll runs, scoped to a Gusto company (company UUID) via OAuth2. Highly sensitive HR/payroll data: no SSN or bank/direct-deposit fields are ever requested or exposed.
apppress/gusto-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/helpdesk.name: HelpDesk Pro
apppress/helpdesk.description: Complete customer support platform: ticketing, SLA management, agent dashboard, knowledge base, and customer portal.
apppress/helpdesk.author: AppPress

apppress/hubspot-connector.name: HubSpot Connector
apppress/hubspot-connector.description: Connect HubSpot CRM for contact, company, and deal sync plus pipeline workflow automation.
apppress/hubspot-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/i18n.name: AppPress Multi-Language
apppress/i18n.description: Shared localization primitive for AppPress — locale management, translation strings, content translation linking, locale detection, RTL support, public locale switcher embeds, and import/export. Consumed by pages, blogs, forms, and app packs via StandardContracts::I18N.
apppress/i18n.author: AppPress

apppress/import-export.name: AppPress Import / Export
apppress/import-export.description: Universal CSV/Excel/JSON import and export framework for AppPress — pluggable resource-type registries, column-mapping UI, background job processing for large files, per-row validation with error reporting, and operator dashboards. Implements StandardContracts::IMPORT_EXPORT so App Packs register importable/exportable types without coupling to this plugin.
apppress/import-export.author: AppPress

apppress/intercom-connector.name: Intercom Connector
apppress/intercom-connector.description: Production Intercom connector for AppPress — create, update, and look up contacts (leads/users), read and search conversations, post admin replies, and inbound webhook triggers for new conversations and new contacts.
apppress/intercom-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/invoices.name: AppPress Invoices
apppress/invoices.description: Standalone invoice management with line items, tax, printable HTML invoices (browser print-to-PDF), payment recording, overdue detection, automated reminders, and public client view links.
apppress/invoices.author: AppPress

apppress/jira-connector.name: Jira Connector
apppress/jira-connector.description: Production Jira Cloud connector for AppPress — find/create/update issues, read/search projects, and workflow automation on real Jira data.
apppress/jira-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/klaviyo-connector.name: Klaviyo Connector
apppress/klaviyo-connector.description: Connect Klaviyo for marketing profile/event management and workflow automation on list-subscribe and email-engagement events.
apppress/klaviyo-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/knowledge-base.name: AppPress Knowledge Base
apppress/knowledge-base.description: Full-featured knowledge base and help center with articles, hierarchical categories, curated collections, revision history, public search, helpfulness voting, mobile help surfaces, and workflow automation for campus support content.
apppress/knowledge-base.author: AppPress

apppress/launch-pro.name: Launch Pro
apppress/launch-pro.description: A high-energy launch theme for waitlists, beta access, newsletters, and referral programs. Violet-and-amber palette, Space Grotesk display type, gradient hero, and conversion-focused email-capture styling layered over the Default theme.
apppress/launch-pro.author: AppPress

apppress/learn-pro.name: Learn Pro
apppress/learn-pro.description: A focused, academic theme for courses, cohorts, and self-paced learning. Indigo-and-gold palette, Fraunces serif headings, a calm scholarly hero, and lesson/progress-cue styling layered over the Default theme.
apppress/learn-pro.author: AppPress

apppress/lightweight-crm.name: Lightweight CRM
apppress/lightweight-crm.description: Track leads, build pipelines, assign tasks, and close deals without the bloat.
apppress/lightweight-crm.author: AppPress

apppress/loyalty.name: AppPress Loyalty
apppress/loyalty.description: Commerce-focused customer loyalty program with tiered points, earning rules, redeemable reward catalog, point expiry, and tier-based benefits.
apppress/loyalty.author: AppPress

apppress/mailchimp-connector.name: Mailchimp Connector
apppress/mailchimp-connector.description: Connect Mailchimp for audience/subscriber management and workflow automation on member subscribe, unsubscribe, and profile-update events.
apppress/mailchimp-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/marketplace.name: AppPress Marketplace
apppress/marketplace.description: Full-featured marketplace platform: package listings, developer accounts, reviews, cloud hosting, and analytics.
apppress/marketplace.author: AppPress

apppress/media.name: AppPress Media Processing
apppress/media.description: Image processing pipeline for the core media library: responsive variants, WebP conversion, EXIF stripping, metadata extraction, background queue processing, operator dashboard, and mobile gallery surfaces. Implements StandardContracts::MEDIA so App Packs and plugins can trigger processing without direct coupling.
apppress/media.author: AppPress

apppress/microsoft-graph-connector.name: Microsoft Graph Connector
apppress/microsoft-graph-connector.description: Microsoft Graph API foundation for AppPress — provides the shared OAuth2/OIDC token manager, throttling-aware Graph client, delta-query helpers, and change-notification framework used by all Microsoft 365 connectors (Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, Excel, Identity).
apppress/microsoft-graph-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/microsoft-identity-connector.name: Microsoft Identity Connector
apppress/microsoft-identity-connector.description: Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD identity and directory connector for CampusLaunch — OIDC login, user/group sync, role mapping from Microsoft groups, delta sync, and JIT user provisioning. The primary SSO and directory foundation for Microsoft 365 universities.
apppress/microsoft-identity-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/minimal.name: Minimal
apppress/minimal.description: An editorial, content-first theme with large serif headings, generous whitespace, and a near-monochrome palette. Ideal for blogs, knowledge bases, and content-heavy apps.
apppress/minimal.author: AppPress

apppress/mixpanel-connector.name: Mixpanel Connector
apppress/mixpanel-connector.description: Mixpanel connector for AppPress — fire-and-forget event tracking via the real-time Track API, plus read/search of user profiles via the Query/Engage API (Service Account auth). Mixpanel's ingestion side is write-only, like Segment: there is no read/update/delete on tracked events because Mixpanel's real API does not expose one.
apppress/mixpanel-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/newsletters.name: AppPress Newsletters
apppress/newsletters.description: Newsletter list management with subscriber opt-in (single or double), HTML issue composition, scheduled or immediate delivery, open and click tracking, public subscribe blocks, mobile FormScreen subscription, and subscriber import/export. Implements StandardContracts::NEWSLETTERS.
apppress/newsletters.author: AppPress

apppress/notes.name: AppPress Notes
apppress/notes.description: Staff-only internal notes and annotations attachable to any entity via polymorphic relations. Operators use the admin dashboard and REST API; field staff use mobile ListScreen, DetailScreen, and FormScreen surfaces. Integrates with workflows (create/delete actions, created/updated/deleted triggers), activity-log audit entries, and outbound webhooks. Not visible to students or public users.
apppress/notes.author: AppPress

apppress/notifications.name: AppPress Notifications
apppress/notifications.description: Multi-channel notification center for AppPress — stored in-app notifications, email, browser push (VAPID), SMS (Twilio), and Expo mobile push. Implements StandardContracts::NOTIFICATIONS so workflows and plugins deliver alerts without direct coupling.
apppress/notifications.author: AppPress

apppress/notion-connector.name: Notion Connector
apppress/notion-connector.description: Production Notion connector for AppPress — query, create, update, and read pages in a connected Notion database via workflow automation.
apppress/notion-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/onboarding.name: AppPress Onboarding
apppress/onboarding.description: User onboarding checklists and guided flows for campus apps. Operators define step-by-step checklists with links, videos, and manual actions; users track progress via member API, embedded page blocks, theme widgets, and mobile surfaces. Integrates with workflows (assign on registration, completion notifications), optional gamification rewards, activity-log audit entries, and the StandardContracts::ONBOARDING service.
apppress/onboarding.author: AppPress

apppress/incidents.name: AppPress Incidents
apppress/incidents.description: The operational heart of an incident-response app: an incident lifecycle (new → acknowledged → responding → resolved) that can be triggered by external events, workflows, or created manually. Kanban triage board, acknowledge/resolve actions, and SLA escalation via the core escalate-unless timer — acknowledge in time and the escalation is cancelled, miss it and severity bumps and the on-call is paged. Vendor-neutral: an incident doesn't care whether it came from a detection platform, a form, or a person.
apppress/incidents.author: AppPress

apppress/fleet-federation.name: Fleet Federation
apppress/fleet-federation.description: Fleet roll-up via app-press→app-press event federation (OPERATIONAL_APPS Phase 4). Installed on child instances, it pushes signed summary events (incident lifecycle auto-federated; anything via the federation.push_event workflow action; 5-minute counter rollups) to a parent instance over the standard external-event.v1 gateway. The parent is just another app-press app whose event source happens to be its children — no new infrastructure, no vendor coupling.
apppress/fleet-federation.author: AppPress

apppress/operations-blocks.name: Operations Blocks
apppress/operations-blocks.description: Spatial and media blocks for operational and monitoring dashboards: a live Leaflet map with markers and zone overlays, a zone-status summary grid, and an evidence media player for video/image clips. Built for real-time operational apps (incident response, facility monitoring, field operations) — every block updates live via the core live-block channel and falls back to polling. Distinct from the geolocation-primitive plugin (apppress/geo): these are opt-in, Leaflet-backed dashboard visuals.
apppress/operations-blocks.author: AppPress

apppress/orders.name: AppPress Orders
apppress/orders.description: Order management system covering the full lifecycle from placement through fulfilment, shipping, delivery, and refunds, with status history, member self-service, mobile surfaces, and StandardContracts::ORDERS for commerce App Packs.
apppress/orders.author: AppPress

apppress/outlook-connector.name: Microsoft Outlook Connector
apppress/outlook-connector.description: Production Outlook connector for CampusLaunch — email sending/search/drafts, calendar event creation/updates, free-busy availability checks, and webhook triggers for both mail and calendar. Merges outlook_mail and outlook_calendar into one package sharing a single Microsoft Graph OAuth2 connection.
apppress/outlook-connector.author: AppPress

apppress/pages.name: AppPress Pages
apppress/pages.description: Read-only CMS surfaces for AppPress Core's page system: shortcodes ([page], [page_menu]), a page-menu widget, block-editor embed blocks, a mobile RichTextScreen surface, an operator metrics dashboard, and workflow triggers/webhooks fired from core's real page lifecycle events. Does not own page storage or CRUD — page creation, editing, and revision history are core's canonical apppress/pages system (Admin -> Pages).
apppress/pages.author: AppPress

apppress/payments.name: AppPress Payments
apppress/payments.description: One-time payments through any installed payment connector (Stripe, Square, or a future gateway implementing the PaymentGateway contract): checkout sessions, payment records, full/partial refunds, receipts, and webhook sync. Implements StandardContracts::PAYMENTS.
apppress/payments.author: AppPress

apppress/pipelines.name: AppPress Pipelines
apppress/pipelines.description: CRM sales pipeline management with configurable stages, deal tracking, activity logging, win/loss analytics, and kanban board view.
apppress/pipelines.author: AppPress

apppress/products.name: AppPress Products
apppress/products.description: Product catalog supporting simple and variable products with variants, category hierarchy, image galleries, stock tracking, and pricing with compare-at prices.
apppress/products.author: AppPress

apppress/progress.name: AppPress Progress & Completion
apppress/progress.description: Step-by-step progress tracking for any model: define steps, record completions per user, calculate percentage, fire completion events, issue certificates, and resume where left off.
apppress/progress.author: AppPress

apppress/projects.name: AppPress Projects
apppress/projects.description: Project and task management with kanban board, milestones, member roles, priority levels, due dates, task comments, and completion tracking.
apppress/projects.author: AppPress

apppress/public-campus-web-connector.name: Public Campus Web Connector
apppress/public-campus-web-connector.description: Public campus web/calendar/directory connector for CampusLaunch — safely ingests public RSS/Atom feeds, iCal/ICS calendars, JSON endpoints, and HTML pages via configured CSS selectors. Full SSRF protection: private IP blocking, URL allowlisting, HTTPS enforcement, size/timeout limits, and robots.txt politeness. Never authenticates — public data only.
